name: temporal-reel-renderer
description: Renderizador determinístico de Reels: uma função do tempo, Chromium headless, 60 fps e FFmpeg.

scripts.storyboard:demo: node scripts/render.mjs --root ../.. --page skills/temporal-reel/demo/index.html --config skills/temporal-reel/demo/timeline.json --work out --storyboard --report reports/temporal-60fps-storyboard.json
scripts.render:demo: node scripts/render.mjs --root ../.. --page skills/temporal-reel/demo/index.html --config skills/temporal-reel/demo/timeline.json --work out --output ../../entregas/TEMPORAL-60FPS.mp4 --report reports/temporal-60fps-render.json
scripts.qa:demo: python3 scripts/validate_temporal.py --config demo/timeline.json --page demo/timeline.js --html demo/index.html --output reports/temporal-60fps-project-qa.json
